---
title: "Forward-estimate revisions"
subtitle: "How estimates for a given variable and out-year have moved across budget updates"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
tar_source("R")

revs <- tryCatch(tar_read(revisions), error = function(e) tibble::tibble())
```

::: {.callout-note}
Each point is one Budget Paper or MYEFO release; the x-axis is the
document's release date. Filter to a jurisdiction, variable, and
forecast fiscal year to see how the estimate has moved as each
Budget update has been released.

This is the vintage-discipline view: it answers
"what was knowable about X at any past point in time?"
:::

```{r}
if (nrow(revs) == 0L) {
  htmltools::p("No revisions yet --- the panel is built from `fiscal_facts` joined to `dim_documents.release_date`; add committed CSVs under `data/extracted/` to populate it.")
} else {
  shared <- SharedData$new(revs |> filter(!is.na(release_date)))

  bscols(
    widths = c(3, 9),
    list(
      filter_select("jur", "Jurisdiction",  shared, ~jurisdiction),
      filter_select("var", "Variable",      shared, ~canonical_label),
      filter_select("fy",  "Forecast year", shared, ~fiscal_year)
    ),
    plot_ly(shared,
            x = ~release_date, y = ~value_aud_mil,
            color = ~doc_type,
            colors = c(budget  = "#1f3a93",
                       myefo   = "#a6611a",
                       outcome = "#5a6c7d"),
            type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
            text = ~document_id,
            hovertemplate = paste(
              "<b>%{text}</b><br>",
              "Released: %{x}<br>",
              "Value: %{y:,.0f} AUD mil<extra></extra>"
            )) |>
      sbm_theme_fiscal(
        title       = "Vintage trail",
        yaxis_title = "AUD millions"
      ) |>
      layout(xaxis = list(title = "Document release date"))
  )
}
```

## All revisions

```{r}
if (nrow(revs) == 0L) {
  htmltools::p("Empty.")
} else {
  revs |>
    arrange(jurisdiction, variable_id, fiscal_year, release_date) |>
    select(jurisdiction, variable_id, canonical_label, fiscal_year,
           release_date, doc_type, value_aud_mil, document_id) |>
    reactable(
      defaultPageSize = 15,
      searchable      = TRUE,
      filterable      = TRUE,
      striped         = TRUE
    )
}
```
